subject.title: Control UI: preview GitHub issues and pull requests on hover

question: Should OpenClaw core own GitHub issue and pull request hover previews in Control UI through a Gateway-backed metadata method, including the bounded public-repository and token-use boundary proposed by the linked PR?
rationale: This is a new user-facing Control UI feature plus Gateway protocol/security boundary, not a broken existing behavior that cleanup automation can close or implement independently.

options.title: Review and sponsor the linked core implementation
options.body: Proceed with the active PR if maintainers accept the bounded Gateway metadata method and any remaining PR review blockers are resolved.

options.title: Defer the core feature
options.body: Keep normal link navigation and close or narrow the PR if the Gateway network/credential surface is not worth adding to core.

recommendation.title: Review and sponsor the linked core implementation
recommendation.body: Proceed with the active PR if maintainers accept the bounded Gateway metadata method and any remaining PR review blockers are resolved.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete owns the issue/linked PR and has the strongest recent history on the surrounding Control UI and Gateway surfaces.
